labels.caption: Demand one slot late on 1 confirmation week (policy seed 0): every policy plans on the previous slot's demand; the guard of Sublet and of greedy renting with the guard still tests the realized slot. (a) Per week, the least primary baseline (filled) or notice-aware policy (open) minus Sublet, each lagged, on the trace cost and on W0 (positive: Sublet costs less; shaded: a negative or missing margin); Sublet is below every primary baseline in 0 of 1 weeks on cost and 0 on W0. (b) Trace cost and (c) W0 per policy: median over the weeks (marker) and min-max (bar), with demand lagged (filled) and revealed (open); grey: all-fallback.
